Focus on learning new things, master a craft, take care of your body, and forgive yourself for past mistakes. When you learn to love your own company, the universe starts sending you people who honor your light. Today, I am surrounded by genuine love and working in a field that fills my heart. I survived those dark years, and you will survive yours too. Better days are quietly making their way to you.
